The MLP mapper baseline is trained with:

- **Optimizer:** Adam
- **Learning rate:** 10⁻³
- **Epochs:** 20
- **Batch size:** 4,096

It is trained with an MSE loss (p. 17, Appendix E, "MLP baseline optimization").

For context, Section 4.4 describes the MLP as a per-(target layer, head, K|V) mapper with two 1,024-unit ReLU hidden layers, trained with Adam on the same MSE loss as ridge. It defers the full settings to Appendix E (p. 7). Appendix E gives the architecture as Linear(dₛ, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, 1024) → ReLU → Linear(1024, dₕᵗ) (p. 17).
